title.zh: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets
title.en: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets

current_state.zh: The Cardano Foundation released CIP-0113, a token standard that lets issuers of regulated assets like stablecoins, funds and bonds enforce identity and sanctions checks on every transfer and freeze, seize or redirect holdings without a network hard fork.
current_state.en: The Cardano Foundation released CIP-0113, a token standard that lets issuers of regulated assets like stablecoins, funds and bonds enforce identity and sanctions checks on every transfer and freeze, seize or redirect holdings without a network hard fork.
